explanation: The bilinear form is the parity of E against the rank-one coefficient pattern c(i,a,b) = r_i(a) h_i(b); the piling-up identity (proved inline) gives the product of (1 - 2 tau) over the support of c, which is rewritten as a power whose exponent splits as sum_i (sum_a [r_i a != 0]) (sum_b [h_i b != 0]) via Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.card_filter and Finset.sum_mul_sum. The inequality is pow_le_pow_of_le_one with each wt(r_i) >= 1.
